module.name: EKS Cluster CNEInstall
module.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR on AWS EKS, lay down the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap and (optionally) the F5BnkGateway chassis CR, and wire AWS IRSA for the CNE controller (IAM role + OIDC trust + SA annotation + rollout-restart).

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge resolves to access_key_id at deploy time.

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge resolves to secret_access_key at deploy time.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name and cluster_oidc_issuer_url for IRSA trust binding
FLO must be running and BNK CRDs registered before applying CNEInstance

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved from credential template (any auth method).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Resolved from credential template.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region (used for the AWS provider client).

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: EKS cluster name. Used for IAM resource naming.

required.name: cluster_oidc_issuer_url
required.description: OIDC issuer URL of the EKS cluster.

required.name: manifest_version
required.description: BNK manifest version (referenced in the CNEInstance CR).

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token (STS / SSO / assumed-role). Empty for static keys.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where CNEInstance CR is created (also where FLO + CNE controller live).

optional.name: flo_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO module — must be true before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: crds_installed
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO — BNK CRDs must be registered before applying CNEInstance.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deploymentSize. One of: Small, Medium, Large.

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: Number of TMM replicas. Typically one per AZ for multi-AZ setups.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Which namespaces the CNE controller watches for Gateway/HTTPRoute CRs. ["All"] = everything.

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NAD names attached to TMM. Defaults to the ipvlan NAD that the future network-setup module will provide.

optional.name: cloud_az_subnet_mappings
optional.description: AWS AZ → subnet mapping for the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap (required for AWS multi-AZ TMM placement). Empty list = skip the ConfigMap (CNE controller will likely misbehave — set this for production).

optional.name: bnk_gateway_chassis
optional.description: F5BnkGateway chassis CR config — required for Gateway-API translation on AWS/EKS. Empty default_listener_networks list = skip CR creation.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the CNEInstance CR lives.

key_outputs.name: cne_controller_role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN assumed by the CNE controller via IRSA.

key_outputs.name: cloud_network_mapping_applied
key_outputs.description: True if the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap was applied.

key_outputs.name: bnk_gateway_chassis_applied
key_outputs.description: True if the F5BnkGateway chassis CR was applied.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once IRSA wiring (annotate + rollout-restart) is complete.
